name: M3_CRS420MI_Add
description:
Create a new application message to notify a specific user about an event in M3. The operation stores the message in the receiver’s application message inbox, sets its status to 10 (created/new), and returns the unique mail id that identifies the message for later retrieval, update, or completion. Actual delivery channels (for example, e‑mail or other inboxes) depend on how the application message type is configured, not on this call.

Application message status values indicate message progress:

- 10 – Created  
- 20 – Opened/displayed  
- 30 – Forwarded  
- 40 – Replied  
- 50 – Completed (action date entered)  
- 80 – Copy created during creation  
- 90 – Filed
